contradictions.source: non erit illicitum si videat vanum
contradictions.english: it will not be illicit if one sees it as vain
contradictions.why: The source says it is not illicit if the practice is seen as vain (useless/empty), but the English implies the subject's perception of vanity makes it licit, whereas the context suggests the author is describing a condition of the practice itself.
